golden_origin: Manually enumerated expected spans and sentence counts; not generated by either query engine

position_index.storage: In-memory array('Q') postings; inspectable JSONL canonical text/mapping and little-endian uint64 postings persisted for experiments

cwb.subset: Positive token eq/sequence/finite gaps/OR only; form mapped to CWB word; result token positions converted through canonical mappings in tests
cwb.all_span_semantics: Enumerate fixed-length gap branches and OR branches, run each independently, union full spans; at most 256 branches
cwb.paged_scope: Native complete NQR branch union, bounded page dump, separate exact-count CQP process. Combined path supports sentence scope only, requires complete trusted sentence/document structures; no business API or durable scheduler.

benchmark.workload: 20 distinct queries (10 atoms, 5 phrases, 5 finite gaps), 20 repeats, 5 concurrent calls; separate high-frequency gap 0..8
benchmark.hardware: Shared Docker Desktop Linux/WSL2 host, each experiment limited to 4 CPUs and 8 GiB
benchmark.synthetic_generator: 20 seeded repeated templates; not a representative real-source capacity claim
benchmark.memory_limitation: Template revisions reuse Python text and token objects. The posting arrays cover the full requested scale, but peak memory substantially understates object storage for heterogeneous real materials.
benchmark.cold_measurement: cold_query_seconds means first execution on a freshly built in-memory index; persisted-index cold restart is not implemented

baseline_results.interpretation: Original Python three-scale observations and first-page failures are retained; later candidate measurements do not replace this baseline.

character_optimization.interpretation: Sequential shared-host repeated-template comparison; original baseline failure remains recorded and this does not establish formal real-source capacity.

cwb_capacity.complete_counts: All 882 calls across the two sizes match independent brute-force template counts, including high-frequency gap queries.
cwb_capacity.measurement_scope: Actual CQP subprocess full dump, Python deduplication, mapping every hit through persisted Unicode coordinates, complete hit/document/sentence counts and first 50 KWIC rows. One revision equals one document and sentence in this synthetic corpus; CQP process startup is included. First execution does not mean OS page cache was evicted.
cwb_capacity.resource_evidence: Build time, file hashes, child CPU/RSS and cgroup memory recorded; disk peak sampled every 0.25 seconds, not an absolute peak.
cwb_capacity.interpretation: Historical full-dump baseline retained: shared 4CPU/8GiB repeated templates; ten-million-token first-page P95 misses the unchanged 3-second threshold. The later separated path is recorded independently below.

pending: Formal capacity acceptance on dedicated 8 vCPU / 32 GiB / 200 GiB SSD hardware with representative real-source recipes
Integrate measured bounded CWB first-page/exact-count path with production API, authorization and durable background tasks; preserve exact overlap and coordinate semantics
Persisted-index cold restart and explicitly controlled cold-disk/page-cache measurements
Real-material memory and disk/temporary-file peak validation; current CWB evidence is shared-host synthetic sampling
Production index reuse and subset quota scenarios; executable identity/byte-admission contract experiment exists separately

report_write_retry.scope: Only report replacement changed to retry PermissionError 5 attempts with at most 0.75s total sleep. Million-token run retained its original runner hash; complete module AST equality is proven after normalizing that one call and helper. No query/count logic changed.

cwb_paged_capacity.workload: Per size: 20 fixed queries x 20 repeats, 5 closed-loop request workers; plus 20 first-execution, 20 warm-up and one high-frequency gap request. Every request starts independent page/count CQP calls, for up to 5 page plus 5 background count processes.
cwb_paged_capacity.scheduling: The request worker submits exact count to a distinct 5-worker pool and executes page immediately, then waits for count before admitting its next request. Count completion is measured from the same request start, including queue delay; actual time overlap is recorded, not inferred from configuration.
cwb_paged_capacity.count_publication: Page result contains null total_hits/matched_segments/matched_documents and pending status. The benchmark publishes completed exact counts only after joining the count future. A count may physically finish before page delivery; those cases are recorded separately.
cwb_paged_capacity.correctness: For every request, token spans and every KWIC field equal an unbounded full-result reference. Reference page hashes also equal the retained historical baseline; complete counts independently verified by raw template enumeration. Separate hand gold checks multi-sentence documents, nested endpoints, duplicate OR, Unicode, non-first/empty pages and missing structure errors.
limitations: No deployed business API, production authorization or durable job scheduler is measured.
Fresh processes and first-execution observations are not cold-disk measurements; OS page cache was not cleared.
Parent/cgroup peak memory includes prior full-dump correctness preparation; per-CQP child RSS is reported separately.
New experiment disk peak is sampled at 0.25s and excludes reused baseline files; it is not a strict absolute peak.

Sequential shared-host measurements are not formal dedicated-hardware acceptance. Original 3s ordinary first-page, 30s ordinary complete-count and 120s high-frequency count thresholds remain unchanged.
cwb_paged_capacity.interpretation: Ordinary first-page observations meet 3s in this shared synthetic experiment; ten-million high-frequency first page is 3.282s and must not be included in a blanket under-3s claim. Original failures remain preserved; formal acceptance remains false.

index_reuse_quota_contract.scope: Immutable identity compatibility and measured regular-file byte admission only; trusted authorization callback invoked before every lookup; subset/mixed paths require new build.
pending: Atomic concurrent quota reservation and publication
Runtime build resource limits, temporary peak and filesystem overhead
